{{Quote|What can I do for you today?|Imperial Space Station to an incoming pilot|<ref name="ROTW" />}}
The '''Imperial Space Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was staffed by a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] Imperial.<ref name="ROTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Space Station was a location in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the [[2005]] expansion pack for the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="ROTW" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
